description: The outcome of one TraceSpan. Running is the only value that keeps a span's bar growing: a running span has no EndedAt, so the layout extends it to the caller's "now". Every non-OK status renders with its own icon and localized text, so an error is never signalled by colour alone.

members.name: Ok
members.description: The span completed successfully. No status chip is rendered.

members.name: Error
members.description: The span failed. Rendered with an error icon, the localized "Error" text and the danger tone.

members.name: Running
members.description: The span is still in flight; its bar extends to "now" and live mode keeps redrawing.

members.name: Cancelled
members.description: The span was cancelled before it completed.
